_doc: Centralised configuration for the rarebert pipeline. Each section maps to a module concern; tweak values here rather than touching the Python source. The keys prefixed with underscore are ignored by the loader and only exist for documentation.

color_scheme._doc: Positional color slots. data-loader.py assigns each label to the next available slot in the order it encounters labels in the TSV.

understand_language._doc: Settings for the scrolling understand_language demo. Span markers and label names are discovered at runtime from the TSV; no literals are stored here.
understand_language._doc_stopwords: Stop-word list is intentionally not stored in source; the demo applies no stop-word filter.

environment._doc: Reserved env-var names. Modules should look these up rather than hardcoding strings.
